entities.summary: Estonian Agricultural Museum is an agricultural museum in Ülenurme, Tartu County, Estonia. The museum exhibits Estonian rural heritage, including culinary traditions, and features Estonia's largest collection of pre-WW2 steam engines and locomotives.
